name: France (Plantation Colony)
title: The Kingdom of France (Plantation Colony)
pressure_shape: Town sprawl: extra Explorers (L1, L6), Explorers replaced by Towns after Builds (L2), extra Towns at Setup (L3) and from Coastal Cities (L4), removed Blight held back (L5); loses if a Town cannot be placed (7 Town per player).

stage_ii_escalation.title: Demand for New Cash Crops
stage_ii_escalation.text: After Exploring, on each board, pick a land of the shown terrain. If it has Town/City, add 1 Blight. Otherwise, add 1 Town.

loss_condition.title: Sprawling Plantations
loss_condition.text: Before Setup, return all but 7 Town per player to the box. Invaders win if you ever cannot place a Town.
loss_condition.steam_text: There is a limit of 7 Town per starting board. Invaders win if you ever cannot place a Town.
loss_condition.note: Box panel text (Brett, Q17): 7 Town per player, also with an extra board. The Steam engine limits Towns per starting board, which differs from the box only with an extra board.

sources: Level titles and text: Steam engine defs (TheKingdomOfFrance), icon tokens written as words, formatting tags removed. Cross-checked against data/references/rules/register.md section 4.4 (Wiki copy). Difficulty and fear decks: box panel values (Brett, 2026-10-19); fear deck = 3 per Terror Level plus the engine offsets. Levels are cumulative: level N applies levels 1..N. is_cliff is unset pending a strategy review.

levels.name: Base
levels.escalation: Escalation (Demand for New Cash Crops): After Exploring, on each board, pick a land of the shown terrain. If it has Town/City, add 1 Blight. Otherwise, add 1 Town. Additional loss condition (Sprawling Plantations): Before Setup, return all but 7 Town per player to the box. Invaders win if you ever cannot place a Town.
levels.notes: R-ADV-FRA-L0a, R-ADV-FRA-L0b. Escalation happens after Exploring.

levels.name: Frontier Explorers
levels.escalation: Except during Setup: After Invaders successfully Explore into a land which had no Town/City, add 1 Explorer there.

levels.name: Slave Labor
levels.escalation: During Setup, put the “Slave Rebellion” Event under the top 3 cards of the Event Deck. After Invaders Build in a land with 2 Explorer or more, replace all but 1 Explorer there with an equal number of Town.
levels.notes: R-ADV-FRA-L2a, R-ADV-FRA-L2b. Slave Rebellion is added to the Event Deck only against France (NI p.5; Q15).

levels.name: Early Plantations
levels.escalation: During Setup, on each board add 1 Town to the highest-numbered land without Town. Add 1 Town to land #1.
levels.notes: R-ADV-FRA-L3. Engine title 'Early Plantations'; Wiki 'Early Plantation'.

levels.name: Triangle Trade
levels.escalation: Whenever Invaders Build a Coastal City, add 1 Town to the adjacent land with the fewest Town.

levels.name: Slow-Healing Ecosystem
levels.escalation: When you remove Blight from the board, put it here instead of onto the Blight Card. As soon as you have 3 Blight per player here, move it all back to the Blight Card.

levels.name: Persistent Explorers
levels.escalation: After resolving an Explore Card, on each board add 1 Explorer to a land without any. Fear Card effects never remove Explorer. If one would, you may instead Push that Explorer.
